item.title: 賣 domain 的 RFC 10023 (_for-sale)
item.summary: 看到「RFC 10023 The "_for-sale" Underscored and Globally Scoped DNS Node Name (via)」這個 RFC，果然什麼東西都有機會發 RFC 啊... 主要是給機器讀的 DNS record： This document defines an operational convention that uses the reserved underscored DNS leaf node name "_for-sale" to indicate the parent domain name is available for purchase. 甚至連價碼都定義了 fval： _for-sale IN TXT "v=FORSALE1;fval=EUR999" 不知道該說什麼的東西，但值得寫下來記錄起來...？
